respuesta.razonamiento: Reconciled visual whiteboard elements with narration. The Expedia Group applications client (UserConsumerAPI) pushes raw data to an S3 ingestion bucket. Processing is handled along two paths: batch processing via Glue and EC2 back into a curated S3 bucket (with the EC2-to-S3 return flow mentioned in speech). A parallel streaming path consumes real-time Kafka events via ECS into Aurora, triggers Lambda processing, queues messages in SQS, and delivers updates to Salesforce Einstein Analytics (represented visually by the direct SQS-to-Salesforce line, with intermediate API calls mentioned in narration folded into this path).
respuesta.nombre: Expedia Group - Batch and Real-Time Event Processing Architecture
